text_block_list.text:
—For disposing of old equipment in the PE 
storage room, I was asked to supervise the 
two students assigned to the task.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I'll be counting on you... 
Trainer. Commencing Mission: 'Oversized 
Garbage Disposal.'

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Don't be in such a rush. Those 
cast off from "Noah's Ark" deserve a 
parting gift.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ? ...A farewell gift, you say—?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It means we haven't completed the crucial 
ritual yet... Look, take that furlong pole 
for example...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
This was used in class right after I 
enrolled. And those "Super Heavy 
Horseshoes" over there, too... They're 
trusted partners that have helped me out 
countless times.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Reflect upon your own genesis. Decaying 
relics of the gods require a requiem, do 
they not?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"The fate of 'parting' is unavoidable. 
However... we can dedicate our friendship 
to that farewell!"
choice_data_list:
You mean you want to "part ways" with your 
equipment...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Things are born to be used. That is 
their very raison d'être...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Before every farewell, I always make sure 
to reflect upon its significance once 
again."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I see... To be used—that is their 
'mission'...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaahhh!! Haah--!!

Tanino Gimlet and Symboli Kris S began 
training at full throttle using equipment 
slated for disposal...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wah, what's all this!? There's so much 
nostalgic training gear! I used to pull 
that giant tire all the time back then!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Nostalgic... huh...? —Will you guys use 
them one last time too?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A & B
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely! Wow, everything is worn 
down to shreds. Hehe... thank you for 
everything. We've really done so much 
training together, haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Engrave this upon your 
heart. For this shall be our eternal 
farewell...

—And the equipment that had been used so 
lavishly was hauled away as oversized 
trash by a waste collection service.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
This is farewell... Ah, the sunset, like 
the Twilight of the Gods, stings my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I was able to reach the end with no 
regrets. I will never forget this day..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I—won't forget either.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I now understand... ...the meaning 
behind you telling me to stop.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I see... Hehehe... This, too, is part of 
my "aesthetic."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, we've seen them off... With this 
sentiment in our hearts, shall we share a 
drink?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
At times like this, one should savor the 
finest wine. I shall treat you. What would 
you like to drink?

Tanino Gimlet looks at me. Thinking of 
parting ways, a mocktail suited for this 
moment would be...
choice_data_list: A flavor that helps you hold back tears

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I see... You wish to overcome today and 
live strongly...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha...! That's the spirit! Yes, smile! 
I'll make you a grape-based mocktail with 
the bold, robust flavor of red wine!

And the three of them sipped the rich 
mocktail she made, slowly taking in the 
lingering feelings of parting.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, that's right. That's exactly what 
we need right now.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A lemon base would be nice. Add some 
refreshing mint, and a pinch of salt to 
substitute for the tears of youth... yeah.

She made me a fizzy, lemon-flavored 
mocktail. The sparkling sensation down my 
throat felt as though it were washing away 
the lingering melancholy...
